lines.text: Kings west of the Jordan heard the news and came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
The Gibeonites carried worn-out sacks and moldy bread to Joshua at Bethel and asked for a treaty.
The Gibeonites told Joshua they had heard of the LORD's deeds in Egypt and to Sihon and Og.
The men of Israel sampled the provisions without seeking the LORD's counsel, and Joshua made a treaty with them.
Israel learned the Gibeonites were neighbors, then set out and reached their cities, including Gibeon and Shiloh.
